description: The same gross salary in two countries: take-home pay, income tax and contributions on each side, converted at the European Central Bank reference rate, with a plain-English summary. Countries: ee, pl, dk, sg, fr, nl, es, de, us, uk, au, nz, ca, ie, in. Use region_a / region_b for a US state, UK nation, Canadian province or Indian state (defaults apply otherwise and are stated in the answer). Returns each side's tax year and official sources. Bonus and other supplemental pay (withholding vs final tax): calculate_supplemental_withholding (sg, fr, nl, es, de, us, uk, au, nz, ca, ie, in). Equity compensation (RSUs, stock options): calculate_equity_tax (us, uk, au, ca, in). Equity earned while working in several countries: calculate_cross_border_equity (tax estimates for sg, nl, es, de, us, uk, au, ca, ie, in). Not yet supported: cross-border salary withholding (multi-country payroll), and the double-tax relief amount (get_tax_treaties lists the treaty withholding limits CalcBloc stores).

country_a.description: Country short code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in lower case; the UK is "uk", "gb" also works), e.g. "us", "uk", "ca", "de", "in", "au", "nz", or the English name. Older keys such as "new-zealand" also work. See list_countries.

country_b.description: Country short code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in lower case; the UK is "uk", "gb" also works), e.g. "us", "uk", "ca", "de", "in", "au", "nz", or the English name. Older keys such as "new-zealand" also work. See list_countries.

currency.description: Currency of gross_salary: country A's or country B's (ISO code). Default: country A's.

region_a.description: Region in country A: a US state ("ca"), UK nation ("scotland"), Canadian province ("on") or Indian state ("mh"). Defaults: New York, England, Ontario, Maharashtra.

region_b.description: Region in country B: a US state ("ca"), UK nation ("scotland"), Canadian province ("on") or Indian state ("mh"). Defaults: New York, England, Ontario, Maharashtra.

name: compare_countries

attribution.description: Always "Data by CalcBloc"; show it with the figures.

calcblocUrl.description: The calcbloc.com page for this result.

sources.description: Official sources for the rates used.

retrievedAt.description: Date CalcBloc last checked the source.

taxYear.description: Tax year of each side, e.g. 2026-27 (United Kingdom) / 2026 (Germany).
